summary_en: TCG2511 K.K. tender offer for Nippon Dry-Chemical shares closed 2026-06-29. 14,162,145 shares tendered and acquired, exceeding minimum threshold of 13,465,700. TCG2511 to become parent company and controlling shareholder (>50% voting rights) effective 2026-07-06 (settlement date). ALSOK K.K., current principal shareholder (16.41%), to cease being major shareholder.
title_en: Notice of Results of Public Tender Offer for Company Shares by TCG2511 K.K. and Notice Regarding Changes in Parent Company, Major Shareholders, and Principal Shareholder
translation_en_brief: Nippon Dry-Chemical announces the results of the public tender offer by TCG2511 K.K., which closed on 2026-06-29. A total of 14,162,145 shares were tendered, exceeding the minimum acceptance threshold of 13,465,700 shares, causing the offer to succeed. TCG2511 will acquire all tendered shares. Upon settlement on 2026-07-06, TCG2511's voting rights will exceed 50% of total shareholder voting rights, making it the new parent company, major shareholder, and principal shareholder of Nippon Dry-Chemical. TCG2511 is itself 50% owned by CJP V HC Holdings XI, L.P. and 50% owned by ALSOK K.K. ALSOK currently holds 4,400,000 shares (16.41%) of Nippon Dry-Chemical and will cease to qualify as a principal shareholder after the settlement. Nippon Dry-Chemical owns 175,000 shares of ALSOK. No capital or personnel relationships exist between the offeror and target prior to the transaction.
